1.old: Port Guichon is one of the older neighbourhoods in Ladner, along the Fraser River, with character homes and quiet streets. Some parts have river views. Homes go from older heritage-style houses to updated family homes, many near the water or on older, settled streets. There are walking paths along the river and parks nearby, and Ladner’s village centre, with its shops, restaurants and services, is a few minutes away.
